label: Phase 003's six activity markers do not cover phase 001's seven groups and the per-row value the markers need is never promised: 001 groups rows under needs_you, working, scheduled, done, stopped, failed and recurring, and its JSON names only id, title and rows per group, while 003 draws six markers with scheduled and recurring unmatched and stale having no group. Name the row keys (runId, botId, status, actor, at) in 001 REQ-002 and extend 003's table to seven groups plus the stale header flag.
Phase 002's routines --json never names botId, which phase 003's routines pane requires for its first column. Add botId to 002 REQ-007's field list and to its --json acceptance row.

Phase 001's inbox --json names its fields in prose (id, bot, state, question, options, timestamps, answer) where its consumers parse exact keys; the item's real keys are id, botId, question, options, createdAt, expiresAt and answer, so bot and timestamps are not keys and two consumers can pick two names. Replace the prose with the exact key list in REQ-003 and add --json key assertions to phase 001's acceptance table.
